task.text:
[0] GDF15 overexpression in female mice improved their metabolism and extended lifespan.

[1] GDF15 overexpression in female mice improved their metabolism and extended lifespan.

[2] GDF15 overexpression in female mice improved their metabolism and extended lifespan.

[3] Hemizygote knockdown of GH1 in rats caused increased lifespan.

[4] Homozygote knockdown of GH1 in rats caused decreased lifespan.

[5] Ectopic expression of the bovine growth hormone gene in mice led to enhanced body growth, shortened lifespan, and reduced replicative potential of cells from different tissues.

[6] Ectopic expression of the bovine growth hormone gene in mice led to enhanced body growth, shortened lifespan, and reduced replicative potential of cells from different tissues.

[7] Hemizygote GH1 knockdown rats had a longer lifespan than the wild type.

[8] GH1 hemizygote knockdown in rats enhanced the life-extending effect of diet restriction and abolished age-associated nephropathy.

[9] GHR deletion in mice caused dwarfism, enhanced insulin sensitivity, and significantly extended longevity. The average lifespan of GHR −/− C57BL/6J male mice was significantly longer than their controls.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
